title: Full-app Playwright QA pass: every screen audited in both languages, themes and phone/desktop
user_story: As the owner I want a strict QA pass over the whole app (agent/PLAYWRIGHT_QA_CHECKLIST.md) that finds even small interface defects (overlap, covered or clipped controls, wrong language, contrast) and fixes them before 6.6.3 ships.

requirements.description: The four agents have an English description (label_en) that the English Settings shows.
Every Vietnamese Harness preset block has an English name (label_en) that the English canvas shows.
The Docker and Python engine names and details are English, like the other engines.

nonfunctional: frontend/e2e/qa_screens.spec.ts with frontend/e2e/uiAudit.ts: 29 screens (main views, 9 Settings tabs, every drawer panel) x 5 cells (en light/dark 1440, en light 390, vi light 1440, vi dark 390) plus 12 topic-dependent screens x 3 cells = 181 tests; rules VIS-HSCROLL, VIS-OCCLUDED, VIS-TARGET, VIS-ICON, VIS-CLIPPED, VIS-TEXT-JUNK, VIS-I18N-KEY, VIS-MIXED-LANG and axe (WCAG 2.1 AA serious/critical)
First run: 128 of 145 failed; final: 181/181, repeated

Frontend fixes: Dashboard, Harness, Topics, Figures, Intelligence, Workstreams and Claims follow the active language; skills, plugins and Harness presets use their English fields; WCAG fixes (contrast, labels, focusable scroll region, target size); the sidebar menu no longer shares its Vietnamese name with a Settings tab; VRAM errors shown inline
outputs: label_en / English engine text used by the interface
postconditions: The English interface shows no Vietnamese chrome on any audited screen
acceptance_criteria: No VIS-MIXED-LANG, axe serious/critical, occlusion or target findings

scenarios.expected: Every agent has label_en without Vietnamese; public config carries it
Each Vietnamese preset block has an English name
No Vietnamese in the Docker and Python names or details (installed, missing, stopped)
At least one Vietnamese preset is checked (the test cannot pass vacuously)
label_en travels through public_config (which still masks secrets)

recovery: Fix the text at its source; never relax the audit rules to pass. TASK-UI-QA-663, max three cycles.
test_environment: Disposable PHDLAB_DATA_DIR (D:/qa663) on loopback port 8791 with a disposable QA project and topic; Chromium headless; evidence in docs/qa/evidence/ui-qa-663/.
